question: The volume (in m³ ) of a cube, each edge of which is 45 m, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a cube is the cube of its side length (a³).

Since the side length is 45 m, the unit digit of its volume will be the unit digit of 5³, which is 5.

Looking at the given options (91321, 91057, 91125, 91128), only 91125 ends with the digit 5.

Therefore, we can directly conclude the answer without full multiplication.

**∴ The correct answer is 91125 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Edge of the cube (a) = 45 m

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cube = a³

 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 a = 45 m
 a = 45 m
 a = 45 m
 
 
 Cube Volume = a³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 45³

⇒ Volume = 45 × 45 × 45

⇒ Volume = 2025 × 45

⇒ Volume = 91125 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 91125 m³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Cube

The total surface area of a cube with side length 'a' is the sum of the areas of its 6 square faces, given by the formula 6a².

Lateral Surface Area of a Cube

The lateral surface area includes only the 4 side faces (excluding the top and bottom bases) and is calculated as 4a².

Diagonal of a Cube

The length of the longest diagonal passing through the body center of the cube from one corner to the opposite is given by a√3.
